name: codex-meshy-multiview
description: Concept sheets to consistent views, textured Meshy models, and Adaptive Low remeshes, with support for existing references.

interface.shortDescription: Concept to textured 3D and Adaptive Low remesh
interface.longDescription: Create concept sheets by default or use existing references, check design consistency, prepare four views with ImageGen, and generate textured Meshy models with separate Adaptive Low remeshes. Includes resumable tasks and local GLB checks.
defaultPrompt: Create a concept sheet, then generate a textured low-poly model from four clean views.
Resume my Meshy workflow and download both models.
